messages:
anya: FYI, small but noisy spike during last rolling deploy where streaming sessions saw duplicated provisional tokens. Pattern isn't the usual midstream reconnect exact-dup caseit's often new session IDs with overlapping chunk ranges but different token counts. Posting a short log snippet.
sam: paste?
kevin: logs (redacted):
```
[2024-08-02T21:10:11Z] session=pp-71 region=us-west route=canary cb=tripped
[2024-08-02T21:10:12Z] toolcall id=tool-vad status=partial chunk=3/8 truncated=true bytes=320
[2024-08-02T21:10:12Z] client reconnect new_session=pp-71b orig_session=pp-71
[2024-08-02T21:10:13Z] billing provisional session=pp-71 tokens=132 chunks=[1,2,3]
[2024-08-02T21:10:14Z] billing provisional session=pp-71b tokens=140 chunks=[3,4]
```
anya: chunk 3 appears in both, but token counts differ slightly. Our ledger keys are session+chunk so dedupe misses.
lucy: Could we compute a cross-session chunk fingerprint server-side (sha256(normalize(prompt)+model_id+chunk_index)) and use that as a ledger key? That would be authoritative even when session provenance is lost.
maria: Fingerprint approach works, but we need normalization rules (strip trailing whitespace, collapse runs of spaces, canonicalize punctuation). Also be careful when model_id is missing or model changes mid-request.
sam: Another idea: rather than immediate merging, produce a "candidate" and surface it in Console for ops to approve for refund. That avoids accidental auto-refunds. We can have two modes: detect-only and auto-apply when confidence is very high.
billing-bot: Billing needs a stable API for this. Prefer shape: POST /internal/billing/merge_proposal with {merge_id, sessions, fingerprints, merged_tokens, evidence}. Billing will apply policy and either auto-execute or queue for manual review. Finance requests initial auto-execute cap of $1k per merge and 10k/day.
kevin: Implementation plan: 1) reconciler calculates chunk_fingerprint and candidate merges when overlapping fingerprints are found across sessions within 3 minutes. 2) candidate includes evidence: {FINGERPRINT_MATCH, TIME_LT_180s, TRUNCATION_FLAG, TOKEN_DELTA=+/-}. 3) score computed from evidence. 4) if score >= 0.95 -> auto-call billing.merge_proposal; if 0.7<=score<0.95 -> post to merge-candidate-log and Console queue for ops.
anya: Telemetry: reconciler.candidate_count, reconciler.auto_merge_count, reconciler.manual_merge_count, reconciler.score_distribution, reconciler.reject_reasons. Console should display merge candidates with quick "Approve refund" and trace link. Lucy can mock.
lucy: I will add a compact card in Cost Explorer: "Merge candidates (streaming)" listing account, score, merged_tokens, and a small expand to show pre-merge lines. Approve flows will POST to billing endpoint and record audit event.
maria: Edge cases: do NOT merge across different customer_account ids. Also, when model_id is absent or differs, reduce score by 0.3. If truncation flag is present from tool service, increase score. We should push tool-team to emit explicit X-Tool-Truncated header for partial responses.
kevin: Router changes: option A: preserve request-id across reconnects if feature flag enabled. Option B: leave existing behavior and rely on fingerprinting+reconciler. Preserving request-id is lowest-latency fix but may change trace shapes; prefer reconciler-first.
sam: Tests: unit tests for fingerprint normalization, integration sim of truncation+reconnect where fingerprint matches but tokens differ slightly, e2e verifying Console candidate -> approve -> billing.apply. Also fuzz tests to ensure no cross-account merges.
deploy-bot: Plan: reconciler.merge-fingerprint -> canary-cluster -> 2024-08-03T03:00Z. Feature flag reconciler.merge_fingerprint=true. Read-only mode first (emit candidates only).
billing-bot: We'll throttle auto-refunds to 5/min for first 2h and cap at $10k/day until finance signs off. Please include merge_id, evidence, and trace link in the merge_proposal payload.
anya: Ops runbook: how to inspect a candidate (trace link -> router logs -> tool logs), how to approve/deny in Console, and how to manually refund if needed. I'll draft and link the runbook on rollout.
kevin: I'll add a merge_id to reconciler outputs and a small dry-run CLI to replay past provisional ledgers to validate heuristic thresholds. ETA: PRs in next 48h.
lucy: UI mock will appear in #design later today. Include an option to "show pre-merge items" for support.
sam: Good plan. If we start seeing many candidates with low scores, we'll iterate on the normalization rules and consider preserving request-id across handoffs as a complementary fix.
maria: Also add a metric for "reconciler.refused_merge_no_provenance" so we can estimate how much router changes would help.
billing-bot: Noted. Will implement merge_proposal endpoint and initial throttles.
anya: Thanks. I'll watch reconciler.score_distribution during canary and keep finance/CS in the loop. If anything looks off we'll rollback the flag.
sam: Thanks all :thumbsup:
